answer: Sybil farms share one clock and mint keys. Admission emits 5 ripple pulses in 70 minutes, each a 24-byte HMAC of (key, index, time rounded to 30s). A 16-minute forge seals them with two notary clocks >=90s apart. The bundle parks on a terrace of 9 slots filled by distinct parents aged 3 epochs. Cost: 16.2 stake, refunded after 2 epochs if clean. The ledger recomputes the five HMACs and rejects /22 overlaps. A pulse gap over 18 min voids the bid and keeps 2.1. Notaries closer than 90s burn 6.5 and bar 4 epochs. A terrace collision burns 16.2 and bars 7 epochs; unfilled in 3h refunds 14.1.
